tweets.body: By directly comparing measured activation domain/co-activator affinities with activation measurements in cells, we further establish that activation levels depend on affinities in an ultrasensitive manner. https://t.co/y8AP8eWTjH

tweets.title: Using STAMMPPING, we find that the metazoan-specific co-activator P300 directly binds >100 activation domains, potentially explaining its widespread recruitm
tweets.body: Using STAMMPPING, we find that the metazoan-specific co-activator P300 directly binds >100 activation domains, potentially explaining its widespread recruitment across the genome to influence transcriptional activation. https://t.co/iPVwNakzyv

tweets.title: We introduce STAMMPPING, a high-throughput method for measuring direct protein-protein interactions for >1500 pairs, by recombinantly expressing and purifyin
tweets.body: We introduce STAMMPPING, a high-throughput method for measuring direct protein-protein interactions for >1500 pairs, by recombinantly expressing and purifying baits in hundreds of microfluidic wells in parallel, and quantifying their binding affinities to labeled preys using 🔬 https://t.co/B3tcZxs67K

tweets.title: Identifying DIRECT interactions and understanding the relationship between affinities and activities requires the ability to accurately quantify thermodynamic c
tweets.body: Identifying DIRECT interactions and understanding the relationship between affinities and activities requires the ability to accurately quantify thermodynamic constants. Unfortunately, traditional in vitro methods for quantifying these affinities are low-throughput and laborious.

tweets.title: Although we’ve known for over three decades ❗️that gene activation is the result of transcription factor activation domains recruiting transcriptional machinery
tweets.body: Although we’ve known for over three decades ❗️that gene activation is the result of transcription factor activation domains recruiting transcriptional machinery to DNA, we still don't have a comprehensive understanding of the interactions that drive activation in human cells

tweets.title: Everyone needs to at least glance at figure 2 of this amazing paper 🌟😍 P300’s C-terminal domain (where the very interesting TAZ2 domain is within) binds chromat
tweets.body: Everyone needs to at least glance at figure 2 of this amazing paper 🌟😍 P300’s C-terminal domain (where the very interesting TAZ2 domain is within) binds chromatin more than the catalytic core alone. Really fundamental stuff for gene regulation.

tweets.body: Check out this preprint if you’re curious about how transcriptional effector domains vary across promoters, cell types, and DNA binding domains. And especially check out Figure 4 - a small activation domain that has better delivery and strength than the current CRISPRa 💪🏼

tweets.body: We identified 100s of new EDs by tiling across transcriptional regulators, fusing these 80 amino acid tiles to an inducible DNA binding domain, and recruiting these fusion proteins to integrated reporter genes. Doing so, produced 2,047 maps like this: https://t.co/uP3uLPIFbV
